$comment: Alpha 0 live plan (app/host/lib/outputs-plan.mjs planFile with allowLive; the host must run with --allow-live). config = the O0 preset data/outputs/presets/youtube-1080p60.json unchanged (user-confirmed 2026-11-03: 1080p60 17 Mbps for the first tests): YouTube H 1920x1080@60 direct (yt-h), YouTube V 1080x1920 (vert), and the Multi rung reencode-tk (1920x1080@60 H.264 CBR 6000 kbps, GPU-scaled from the H canvas) shared by twitch and kick. extraSinks adds the local recordings, .mkv (crash-safe), each on a stream rung (no extra encoder): H on yt-h, and V on vert (LC1, D333 proposed: the user asked for clips while live and reels from them; the kill montages and match reels are cut from the V recording). record-v is optional: a start without the V stream (--sinks / output toggles) leaves it out instead of adding an encoder. The host names the files alpha-<stamp>.mkv and alpha-v-<stamp>.mkv. Targets carry Credential Manager target names only (keyRef, serverRef), never a key or a per-account URL. YouTube's ingest URL comes from data/platforms/youtube.json (ingest, UNVERIFIED until compared with YouTube Studio); Twitch and Kick servers are the user's choice / per account and live in Credential Manager. Twitch's transport is "auto" (D309 proposed): rtmp or rtmps, following the scheme of the server address stored in Ujwalam/stream/twitch-server, read at output build time and never kept (data/platforms/twitch.json protocols takes both); Kick names rtmps (its only protocol).
